title: Intra-Agent Motion and Inter-Agent Relation Learning for Map-Free Trajectory Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2512.02368v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Trajectory prediction is essential for safe planning and decision-making in autonomous driving. Map-free prediction improves deployment flexibility by removing the dependence on high-definition maps, but it also loses explicit road-topology and lane-connectivity priors. Consequently, the model must recover stable motion cues from short histories while resolving prospective interaction relations without lane-level guidance. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a map-free trajectory prediction framework centered on a novel Goal-Conditioned Expert-Routed Transformer (GCERT). A lightweight intra-agent front-end first decomposes projected historical motion features into a smooth trend and a local detail residual through a centered moving average. translated_title: 面向无地图轨迹预测的智能体内部运动与智能体间关系学习
translated_abstract: 轨迹预测对于自动驾驶中的安全规划与决策至关重要。无地图预测通过摆脱对高精地图的依赖提升了部署灵活性，但也丧失了显式的道路拓扑与车道连接先验。因此，模型必须在没有车道级引导的情况下，从短时历史中恢复稳定的运动线索，并解析潜在的交互关系。为应对这些挑战，本文提出了一种以新型目标条件专家路由Transformer (GCERT) 为核心的无地图轨迹预测框架。一个轻量级的智能体内部前端首先通过中心滑动平均将投影后的历史运动特征分解为平滑趋势和局部细节残差，组件特定的残差投影对这两个信号分别进行变换，再由因果时序Transformer 总结其重组后的演化。GCERT 采用双层专家路由机制……
tldr: 本文提出一种以目标条件专家路由Transformer (GCERT) 为核心的无地图轨迹预测框架，通过智能体内部运动分解与智能体间关系学习，弥补缺少高精地图道路拓扑和车道连接先验带来的挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a map-free trajectory prediction framework centered on a novel Goal-Conditioned Expert-Routed Transformer (GCERT), which learns intra-agent motion and inter-agent relations to compensate for the absence of high-definition map priors.
